title: Regular scalar Koszul resolutions and the four-term quotient exact row
statement:
Let $\mathcal C$ be a site small relative to the module universe, $R$ a sheaf of commutative rings and $t$ a global section such that multiplication by $t$ is injective on $R(U)$ for every site object $U$. Use sheaves of modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], cochain conventions [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] and total tensor complexes [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves]. Put $B_k=R/t^kR$ for $k\geq1$, with its canonical quotient projection and reduction maps, where quotient means sheafification of sectionwise quotient. The augmented complex $K_k=[R\xrightarrow{t^k}R]\to B_k[0]$, in degrees $-1,0$, has augmentation the quotient in degree zero and zero elsewhere; it is a finite free K-flat resolution [def-pc-kflat-complex]. For $n\geq m\geq1$, total tensor with $B_n[0]$ identifies $B_n\otimes_R K_m$ with $P_{n,m}=[B_n\xrightarrow{t^m}B_n]$, in the same degrees, and its augmentation to $B_m[0]$ is coefficient reduction in degree zero. There is a well-defined $B_n$-linear map $a_{n,m}:B_m\to B_n$ characterized on local representatives by $\bar x\mapsto t^{n-m}x\bmod t^n$. The sequence of $B_n$-module sheaves
$$0\longrightarrow B_m\xrightarrow{a_{n,m}}B_n\xrightarrow{t^m}B_n\xrightarrow{\mathrm{red}}B_m\longrightarrow0$$
is exact. Its left image is the ideal subsheaf $t^{n-m}B_n$. All assertions include $n=m$, with $a_{m,m}=1$ and middle scalar map zero.

proof.text: Apply lem-sp-regular-scalar-quotient-presentation to the chosen positive level. Apply the exact degree-zero single functor to this short exact module sequence, and use mappingCone.descShortComplex. Its quasi-isomorphism property follows from lem-pc-cone-short-exact-quasi-iso. The inr-desc equation and the single functor component formula give the required degree-zero quotient normalization.

The cone term in degree i is R[0]^(i+1) biproduct R[0]^i. At -1 and 0 a zero summand disappears, giving the asserted unit isomorphisms; elsewhere both summands are zero. The unit is flat by its tensor unit isomorphisms, zero is flat, and finite biproducts preserve flatness. Thus the cone is bounded above with flat terms. Apply the independent-coefficient bounded-flat criterion, which has exactly the universes of the statement, to obtain K-flatness. The zero and finite-biproduct flatness instances are supplied by the adopted source flat/K-flat API; they are proved categorical facts, not additional unproved lemmas.

Obtain the ring reduction and the exact module row from lem-sp-regular-scalar-quotient-module-row. Its second zero composite constructs the augmentation from the scalar cone P to the single of the endpoint, using mappingCone.descShortComplex of the degree-zero single of that short complex. No short exactness of this two-arrow complex is claimed or needed. The inr-desc equation gives its normalized degree-zero component.

Choose the normalized chain isomorphism from lem-sp-regular-scalar-quotient-tensor-comparison. Combine its two coordinate equations with the module row and the constructed augmentation. This is the full required conjunction, including the image subobject and the diagonal identities, without changing any quotient or scalar map.

lean.statement:
theorem regularScalarQuotient_exactRow
    (hregular : ∀ U : Cᵒᵖ, Function.Injective
      (fun x : R.obj.obj U ↦ (@id (R.obj.obj U) (t.val U)) * x)) :
    (∀ k : ℕ, ∃ ε : principalKoszul R t k ⟶ single (Q R t k),
      CochainComplex.IsKFlatResolutionIndependentCoefficients ε ∧
      koszulRight R t k ≫ ε.f 0 = ringMap (projection R t k) ≫ singleIn (Q R t k) ∧
      Nonempty ((principalKoszul R t k).X (-1) ≅ unit R) ∧
      Nonempty ((principalKoszul R t k).X 0 ≅ unit R) ∧
      ∀ i : ℤ, i ≠ -1 → i ≠ 0 → IsZero ((principalKoszul R t k).X i)) ∧
    ∀ (n m : ℕ) (_hm : m ≤ n),
      ∃ red : B R t n ⟶ B R t m,
      projection R t n ≫ red = projection R t m ∧
      ∃ (a : (res red).obj (unit (B R t m)) ⟶ unit (B R t n))
        (ε : P R t n m ⟶ single ((res red).obj (unit (B R t m))))
        (e : tensor R t n m ≅ restrictedP R t n m),
        (∀ (U : Cᵒᵖ) (x : R.obj.obj U),
          a.val.app U ((projection R t m).hom.app U x) =
            (projection R t n).hom.app U ((@id (R.obj.obj U) (t.val U)) ^ (n - m) * x)) ∧
        rightIn (B R t n) (scalarImage R t (projection R t n))
            (unit (B R t n)) (m + 1) ≫ ε.f 0 =
          ringMap red ≫ singleIn ((res red).obj (unit (B R t m))) ∧
        tensorIn R t n m (-1) (koszulLeft R t m) ≫ e.hom.f (-1) =
          (res (projection R t n)).map
            (leftIn (B R t n) (scalarImage R t (projection R t n))
              (unit (B R t n)) (m + 1)) ∧
        tensorIn R t n m 0 (koszulRight R t m) ≫ e.hom.f 0 =
          (res (projection R t n)).map
            (rightIn (B R t n) (scalarImage R t (projection R t n))
              (unit (B R t n)) (m + 1)) ∧
        Mono a ∧ Epi (ringMap red) ∧
        (∃ ha : a ≫ mul (B R t n) (scalarImage R t (projection R t n))
            (unit (B R t n)) (m + 1) = 0,
          (ShortComplex.mk a (mul (B R t n) (scalarImage R t (projection R t n))
            (unit (B R t n)) (m + 1)) ha).Exact) ∧
        (∃ hb : mul (B R t n) (scalarImage R t (projection R t n))
            (unit (B R t n)) (m + 1) ≫ ringMap red = 0,
          (ShortComplex.mk (mul (B R t n) (scalarImage R t (projection R t n))
            (unit (B R t n)) (m + 1)) (ringMap red) hb).Exact) ∧
        imageSubobject a = imageSubobject
          (mul (B R t n) (scalarImage R t (projection R t n))
            (unit (B R t n)) (n - m)) ∧
        (∀ h : n = m,
          red = eqToHom (congrArg (B R t) h) ∧
          (∀ (U : Cᵒᵖ) (x : (B R t m).obj.obj U),
            a.val.app U x = (eqToHom (congrArg (B R t) h.symm)).hom.app U x) ∧
          mul (B R t n) (scalarImage R t (projection R t n))
            (unit (B R t n)) (m + 1) = 0)
lean.note: Natural level n denotes the positive exponent n+1. Reuses principalPowerRingQuotient and principalKoszul; all existential arrows are pinned by quotient-projection or coordinate equations. The two-term comparison is an actual normalized chain isomorphism, and the exact row is stated over B_n. W3: all original notation declarations moved unchanged to RegularScalarQuotientNotation and re-exported publicly; their lean attachment is def-sp-regular-scalar-quotient-notation. The parent statement is unchanged up to the unused binder name _hm.
